We help people start, run and grow their businesses with simple, transparent banking and tools that reduce financial admin, so they can spend more time focusing on what matters most.</p> <p>We're launching Monzo Business in Spain, initially focusing on sole traders and simple micro-businesses. While many customers will use a self-serve journey, we know there are moments where speaking to a real person can make all the difference.</p> <p>As our founding Spanish Sales Account Executive, you'll be based in London as part of our UK Sales team, and working closely with Spain Go-To-Market, Product and Marketing teams. You'll combine hands-on sales with gathering customer insight — helping potential customers move forward while shaping the playbook for how Sales can best support our growth in Spain.</p> <p>This is more than just a traditional Sales AE role focused solely on sales conversion. You will also have the opportunity to test, learn and influence how we build a safe, effective and scalable sales motion for Spain from the ground up.</p> <p><br><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage with prospective Spanish SMB customers through discovery calls, emails and messaging, and understand their business, challenges, goals and requirements.</li> <li>Be a product expert: fully understand Monzo's business banking products, features and services. Explaining Monzo Business's proposition, product capabilities and application process clearly, helping customers understand their next step without providing financial, tax, legal or regulatory advice.</li> <li>Drive full sales cycle, from early prospecting and qualification; to demos and sales;  to ensuring successful account switch and activation. Drive activation: not just closing, but ensuring new business customers are fully set up and onboarded.</li> <li>Understand and capture detailed customer objections and feedback. Turn customer conversations into structured and actionable learnings and insights by identifying recurring questions, unmet needs, and journey friction and more.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Go To Market, Product and Marketing teams by collecting, analysing and sharing sales feedback to help teams make rapid and data-driven adjustments</li> <li>Manage a pipeline of leads with strong attention to data hygiene: timely follow-ups, accurate forecasting, deal tracking. Qualifying and prioritising opportunities, handling objections and following up consistently to help customers progress through their journey.</li> <li>Helping shape our Spain sales playbook, including messaging, qualification, objection handling, scripts and customer journeys. Help create and refine Spanish-language scripts, FAQs, objection handling and sales processes.</li> <li>Deliver outstanding service at every touchpoint: via phone, video, email, text or digital channels.</li> <li>Achieve sales targets: conversion, activations, revenue, engagement and other growth metrics as set by the commercial leadership.<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have hands-on sales experience, ideally as an Account Executive, Sales Development Representative or Business Development Representative, and are comfortable qualifying opportunities, handling objections and following up with customers.</li> <li>Strong familiarity with Spanish culture, customer expectations and communication styles, and the judgement to adapt your approach accordingly.</li> <li>Fluent Spanish and English, with excellent written and verbal communication in both languages.</li> <li>Strong consultative communication skills: you listen carefully, ask thoughtful questions and explain complex topics simply.</li> <li>Ability to build trust with customers who may be unfamiliar with Monzo or uncertain about changing their banking setup.</li> <li>You have experience gathering, structuring and analysing commercial or customer data. You enjoy working cross-functionally and can turn what you're hearing from customers into useful insights for teams such as Product, Marketing, Operations, Risk and Compliance.</li> <li>You have experience selling to or supporting small businesses, ideally within financial services, SaaS or another complex service environment.</li> <li>You're excited by experimentation and comfortable working in an early-stage, fast-changing environment where you'll help shape processes and playbooks as well as follow them.</li> <li>You're highly organised, comfortable working with CRM tools or structured customer data, and bring strong judgement, integrity and customer care to every interaction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points if you have experience with:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Selling to or supporting Spanish sole traders, micro-businesses or SMEs.</li> <li>Banking, payments or another regulated industry.</li> <li>Selling a new and unfamiliar product to market</li> <li>Customer research, voice-of-customer programmes, sales enablement or GTM experimentation.</li> <li>Background in consultative services. </li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission)</p> <p>📍This role can based in our London office or remotely in the UK</p> <p>ℹ️ Please note this will be a 12 month fixed-term-contract</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>20 min recruiter call</li> <li>30 min call with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>Take home task and in person task review</li> <li>45 min behavioural interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. The squad sits in Payments, but partners deeply with Finance teams to build the systems, abstractions and capabilities Monzo needs to operate safely, scale efficiently, and expand into new markets. You’ll work on foundational financial infrastructure: the ledgers, data, controls, reporting, reconciliation and platform capabilities that help Monzo understand, account for and manage money across the bank.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited by complex, technical infrastructure. The work is often behind the scenes, but it’s business-critical: it helps Monzo scale, launch new products and markets, support Finance, and keep the bank running safely.</p> <p> </p> <h4>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</h4> <ul> <li>Defining the product strategy and roadmap for Finance Infrastructure within Payments Platform.</li> <li>Partnering closely with Engineering, Finance and Payments leaders to understand what Monzo needs from its financial systems today and as we scale.</li> <li>Moving the team from reactive delivery towards a more strategic, product-led approach, asking why we’re building things, what good looks like, and how today’s choices support Monzo’s long-term needs.</li> <li>Translating complex finance, accounting, operational and regulatory needs into scalable platform capabilities.</li> <li>Prioritising across competing stakeholder needs, balancing urgent delivery with long-term system health.</li> <li>Helping Monzo build financial infrastructure that can support multiple products, entities, countries, currencies and regulatory environments.</li> <li>Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Product and Operations.</li> <li>Bringing strong product discipline, technical curiosity and systems thinking to a space that is critical to Monzo’s future growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h4>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</h4> <ul> <li>You’re a strong senior Product Manager with experience owning complex technical, platform, infrastructure or financial systems.</li> <li>You have enough technical depth to partner credibly with engineers and reason about systems, trade-offs, dependencies and long-term architecture.</li> <li>You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, reconciliation, financial data, controls, reporting, internal platforms, abstractions or backend systems.</li> <li>You can work with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Engineering, Product and operational teams.</li> <li>You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards long-term strategy.</li> <li>You’re high-agency, ambitious and excited to stretch yourself in a team with a high bar.</li> <li>You care about customers and business outcomes, even when the work is several layers removed from the end customer experience.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? our business customers.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Product Strategy & Vision</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set a bold, customer-centric, commercially grounded product strategy for Business Banking.</li> <li>Develop and articulate a compelling long-term product vision that positions Monzo as the leader in differentiated business financial experiences.</li> <li>Combine customer insights, market trends, and commercial priorities into a roadmap that delivers measurable business impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Innovation & Differentiation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Foster a culture of innovation that challenges conventions and inspires teams to build category-defining experiences.</li> <li>Identify and pursue opportunities to meaningfully differentiate Monzo’s business banking offerings.</li> <li>Drive teams to create unique, delightful products based on exceptional product taste.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Analytical & Strategic Depth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spar with data scientists and use data to understand “the why” behind customer behaviour, product performance, and opportunities.</li> <li>Help teams deepen their analytical thinking, improving decision-making quality across the org.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Execution & High-Performance Culture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build an execution engine that consistently delivers against ambitious goals.</li> <li>Create extreme clarity on priorities, establish strong processes, remove blockers, and maintain team momentum.</li> <li>Instil a culture of ownership, speed, and high performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership & Organisational Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a self-starter with a strong bias for action—willing to lead from the front when needed and empower from behind when that’s best.</li> <li>Take full ownership of the Business Banking product area, operating with autonomy and accountability.</li> <li>Identify organisational inefficiencies and design structures that enable teams to thrive.</li> <li>Hire, coach, and develop exceptional product managers, helping them reach their full potential and cultivating the next generation of Monzo product leaders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a seasoned product leader, and have a track record of leading high-performing product teams at a fast-growing consumer tech company to:</li> <ul> <li>build highly engaging (daily/weekly) experiences for millions of customers</li> <li>deliver company trajectory-changing impact</li> <li>(nice-to-have) build a multi-market product, with a proven ability to balance priorities across geographies</li> </ul> <li>You're data-driven and commercial, and have a track record of collaborating with data scientists to define key metrics, run experiments, and deliver business impact.</li> <li>You can systematically break down and solve complex problems.</li> <li>You have good judgement, and you’re able to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”. </li> <li>You have the urge and resilience to challenge the status quo and make things better, and are full of creative ideas for how to do so.</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles - spanning engineering, design, data, user research, marketing, legal and compliance - to get stuff done.</li> <li>You’re a great storyteller, who is able to motivate, energise and inspire people towards a common goal.</li> <li>You’re passionate about building value for customers and not just achieving business results, and are excited about our mission at Monzo.</li> <li>You’re intellectually honest about your work's performance, continually striving for improvement. </li> <li>You’re a fast learner, humble and curious, and enjoy learning every day and sharing your knowledge and experience.</li> <li>You’ve managed a team of PMs, have a proven ability to coach and develop others, and can provide clear and constructive feedback to your team and other disciplines.</li> <li>You can get hands-on when necessary, to fill gaps - in people or experience - and set a practical example for what great looks like.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary dependent upon experience + Stock Options + Benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can title: General Counsel
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong>, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will <strong>own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture</strong> and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.</p> <p><strong><em>Location: </em></strong><em>This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones, with an option to be office based in London, UK.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.</li> <li>Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.</li> <li>Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.</li> <li>Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.</li> <li>Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.</li> <li>Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>Substantial senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business.</li> <li>Proven experience leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>Technology related experience of: <ul> <li>negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services</li> <li>advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience of, or demonstrable readiness for, public company governance: listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practicing as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role. This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits.
